title: Worst colors ever!
text: I hoped I might get at least one product that was good! I got a full coverage GRAY lip gloss...really???  A matte dull peach lipstick...yuck!  A clear lip gloss...mehh.  And a pot of dull dirt colored eye shadow...come on!!!  What are these?  The leftovers that didn't sell so you trick us into buying them.  Nothing at all like the colors shown online.  And the bag...not a real cosmetic bag but a tiny red velveteen bag about the size of a pack of cigarettes...and it looked moth eaten in places!  Oh my goodness...I wouldn't pay 5 cents for this junk!  Don't be fooled by the pictures online!
label: negative
